For mixed-use hotel developments in Latin America—combining a hotel with residences, offices, retail, entertainment, or medical space—the initial brand shortlist typically centers on **Marriott, Hilton, Accor, Hyatt, IHG, and Wyndham**. These are often described as the region’s leading international hotel groups. ([hotelresortdesign-south.com](https://hotelresortdesign-south.com/who-are-the-latam-hotel-industrys-big-six/?utm_source=openai))

### Commonly considered brands by positioning

| Positioning / development type | Representative brands |
|---|---|
| **Luxury hotel + branded residences** | Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, JW Marriott, W; Waldorf Astoria, Conrad; Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Andaz; Fairmont, Raffles, Sofitel; InterContinental, Kimpton, Six Senses |
| **Upper-upscale urban mixed-use** | Marriott, Westin, Renaissance, Sheraton; Hilton; Hyatt Regency, Hyatt Centric; Pullman, MGallery; Crowne Plaza, Hotel Indigo, voco |
| **Lifestyle-led projects** | W, EDITION, Autograph Collection; Canopy, Curio Collection; Thompson, The Standard, Andaz, Hyatt Centric; Mondrian, SLS, SO/, MGallery; Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Vignette Collection |
| **Select-service hotel with offices or retail** | Courtyard, AC Hotels, Aloft, Four Points; Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton, Tru; Hyatt Place; Novotel, ibis Styles; Holiday Inn Express; Wyndham, TRYP, La Quinta |
| **Extended-stay / residential-style** | Residence Inn, Element; Homewood Suites, Home2 Suites; Hyatt House; Adagio; Staybridge Suites |
| **Independent or conversion-oriented component** | Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Luxury Collection; Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection; The Unbound Collection by Hyatt; MGallery; Vignette Collection; Registry Collection Hotels |

### Groups especially relevant to mixed-use

- **Marriott International:** Frequently shortlisted because of its broad segment coverage, dual-brand capability, and established hotel-plus-residences platform. Marriott describes itself as an experienced operator and brander of mixed-use residential projects. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/hotel-development?utm_source=openai))
- **Accor:** Particularly relevant when branded residences, lifestyle concepts, coworking, or multiple hospitality components are contemplated. Accor One Living provides a dedicated mixed-use and branded-residential platform. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/hotel-development/solutions-for-every-project?mdrv=group.accor.com&utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton:** Strong candidates range from focused-service brands to Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, Curio and Canopy. Hilton has been actively expanding branded residences and luxury/lifestyle projects in Latin America. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-ends-2025-with-robust-luxury-and-lifestyle-growth-across-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt:** Hyatt Place and Hyatt Centric have an established history in Latin American mixed-use developments, while Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Andaz and Thompson are candidates for luxury and lifestyle projects. ([latamhotelcorp.com](https://latamhotelcorp.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **IHG:** InterContinental, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Vignette and voco are common upper-tier candidates. Recent regional examples include Kimpton hotels and residences within mixed-use projects in Monterrey and Tulum. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2024/kimpton-expands-presence-in-mexico-with-signing-of-hotel-and-branded-residences-in-monterrey?utm_source=openai))
- **Wyndham:** Often considered for midscale, upscale and conversion opportunities through Wyndham, Wyndham Grand, TRYP, Dazzler, Esplendor, La Quinta and Registry Collection.

### Regional and Spanish operators

Depending on the country and target market, developers may also consider:

- **Meliá:** Gran Meliá, ME by Meliá, Paradisus, Meliá and INNSiDE  
- **Grupo Posadas:** Live Aqua, Grand Fiesta Americana, Fiesta Americana and Fiesta Inn—particularly in Mexico  
- **Minor Hotels:** Anantara, Tivoli and NH Collection  
- **Barceló Hotel Group:** Royal Hideaway, Barceló and Occidental  
- **Palladium Hotel Group:** BLESS, Only YOU, TRS and Grand Palladium  
- **GHL Hoteles / Sonesta:** Relevant in parts of Central and South America  
- **City Express by Marriott:** Frequently relevant for efficient urban and business-oriented developments  

In practice, a credible RFP shortlist usually includes **three to six brands within the same competitive tier**, selected according to residential-brand premium, room count, shared-amenity strategy, market exclusivity, fee structure, distribution strength, design standards and the operator’s local track record. For a true hotel-and-residences project, luxury and lifestyle flags usually provide the strongest residential sales proposition; for office-and-retail complexes, select-service brands such as **Courtyard, Hilton Garden Inn, Hyatt Place, AC Hotels and Holiday Inn Express** are often more operationally efficient.
